name: Cis-(−)-metazocine
summary: Metazocine is an opioid analgesic related to pentazocine. While metazocine has significant analgesic effects, mediated through a mixed agonist–antagonist action at the mu opioid receptor, its clinical use is limited by dysphoric and hallucinogenic effects which are most likely caused by activity at kappa opioid receptors (where it is a high-efficacy agonist) and/or sigma receptors.

pharmacology.text: While metazocine has significant analgesic effects, mediated through a mixed agonist–antagonist action at the mu opioid receptor, its clinical use is limited by dysphoric and hallucinogenic effects which are most likely caused by activity at kappa opioid receptors (where it is a high-efficacy agonist) and/or sigma receptors.

uses.en: It is not used in medicine because of its unpleasant mental effects. It is of interest in research on opioid receptors.
uses.zh: 由於會造成令人不適的精神作用，它並未用於醫療，主要在鴉片類受體的研究中受到關注。
uses.zhHans: 由于会造成令人不适的精神作用，它并未用于医疗，主要在鸦片类受体的研究中受到关注。

sideEffects.en: It can cause dysphoria, an uneasy or unhappy mood, and hallucinations, along with typical opioid effects such as drowsiness, nausea and slowed breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 它可能造成煩躁不安的情緒與幻覺，同時伴隨嗜睡、噁心與呼吸抑制等典型鴉片類作用。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它可能造成烦躁不安的情绪与幻觉，同时伴随嗜睡、恶心与呼吸抑制等典型鸦片类作用。

fact.en: The kappa opioid activity that makes metazocine hallucinogenic is the same receptor action through which salvinorin A, from the plant Salvia divinorum, causes its effects.
fact.zh: 讓 metazocine 具有致幻作用的 κ 鴉片類受體活性，與鼠尾草（Salvia divinorum）中的 salvinorin A 產生作用的受體機制相同。
fact.zhHans: 让 metazocine 具有致幻作用的 κ 鸦片类受体活性，与鼠尾草（Salvia divinorum）中的 salvinorin A 产生作用的受体机制相同。
